notes.title: New version anounce
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27960422/b3e3693c7e89365273283b5bfe613c78a545d582.jpg

Hi, good news.
This summer, we will release a new version of DPS, fast, convenient,
with lighting/shading, and an improved UI.
Although there is still a lot of work ahead - almost all the main features are already working.
Here is a full-size screenshot.
